notes.title: Bug fix on final music puzzle
notes.notes:
Some players have reported that the game stops at the "Live Music Show" puzzle at the end of the game. It was happening only on "Low quality" settings. 
We have fixed the issue, so you can download and continue playing.

notes.title: Important Bug fix, Please update and play
notes.notes:
There was an unfortunate last minute bug that was causing to finish the game too early without collecting all the sounds.

It has been fixed. Please update and play.  


-Cemre Ozkurt
